topic: Pension deyom ki swikriti prakriya ka vikendrikaran — Mukhya Lekha Adhikari ko adhikar
issuing_authority: Vitt Sachiv, UP Shaasan, Vitt (Samanya) Anubhag-3
content:
Mahalekhakaar ke sthar par pension pradhikar patra nikalane mein aa rahi kathinaiyon ke pariprekshya mein shaasan dwara nirnay liya gaya ki pension, gratuity aur rashikaran ke pradhikar patron ko nikalne ki karywahi ka vikendrikaran kiya jaye. Ab yeh karya Mukhya Lekha Adhikari dwara kiya jayega. Yeh pranali 31-07-1985 ko ya uske baad sevanivritt hone wale sabhee karmiyon par laagu hogi.

MLA hi pension, gratuity aur rashikaran swikriti denge

31-07-1985 ke baad sevanivritt hone wale sabhee karmiyon par laagu

Master Register Form-1 aur Pension Check Register Form-2 maintain karna anivaarya

Sevanivritt se 8 maah poorv pension prapatra MLA ko bheja jayega

Sevanivritt ke 1 maah poorv pension, gratuity aur rashikaran ka bhugtan aadesh jaari

Sabhi PPO par embossing seal lagayi jayegi

topic: Vetan Samiti UP 2008 — 01-01-2006 ke baad sevanivritt karmiyon ki pension/gratuity/parivarik pension aur rashikaran ki daron ka punarikshan
content:
Vetan Samiti UP 2008 ki sanstutyon ko swikar karte hue Rajyapal ne sabhee civil pensionaron ki pension, parivarik pension, gratuity aur rashikaran ki daron ko sanshodhit kiya. Yeh aadesh 01-01-2006 se prabhavi.

Pension: antim aahrit vetan ke 50% ya average emoluments ka 50% jo adhik ho

Nyuntam pension Rs.3500 pratimah

Poorn pension hetu 20 varsh ki seva anivaarya — pehle 33 varsh tha

10 varsh ke baad bhi pension ke yogya

Sabhee gratuity ki adhiktam seema Rs.10 lakh

Parivarik pension: mool vetan ka 30% — nyuntam Rs.3500, adhiktam Rs.24000

Parivarik pension avadhi: mrityu ke baad 10 varsh tak ya 65 varsh ki aayu tak — pehle 7 varsh tha

Vriddh pensionaron ko atirikt pension: 80-85 varsh=20%, 85-90=30%, 90-95=40%, 95-100=50%, 100+=100%

topic: Invalid Pension — Ashakata ke aadhar par pension niyam 441-447
content:
Kisi adhikari ko shareerik ya maansik ashakata ke kaaran saarvajanik seva ke liye sthayi roop se asamarth ghoshit kiye jaane par Invalid Pension di jaati hai. Medical Board se praman patra aavashyak hai.

Rule 441: Sthayi shareerik ya maansik ashakata par hi Invalid Pension

Rule 442(b)(1): Gazetted Officers ke liye Medical Board anivaarya

Rule 442(b)(2): Anyatha Civil Surgeon ka praman patra manya

Rule 444: Sirf vriddhavastha kehna kaafi nahi — 55 varsh se kam aayu mein detailed reason zaroori

Rule 447: Bharat mein nirdharit praarup — ashakata adat se sambandh nahi hona chahiye

topic: UP Police Asadharan Pension Rule 3 vyakhya — kartavyapal mein hriday rog ya cerebral thrombosis se mrityu par bhi Award
content:
UP Police Asadharan Pension Niyamavali 1961 ke Rule 3 ki vyakhya karte hue shaasan ne spasht kiya ki kartavyapal ke dauran hriday rog ya cerebral thrombosis se mrityu hone par bhi Asadharan Pension Award deya jayega.

Kartavyapal mein mrityu mein sirf sashatra sangharsh nahi sabhi kartavya shamil

Hriday rog ya cerebral thrombosis se bhi kartavyapal mein mrityu par Award

Kanstebil Ramaayan Singh case — precedent confirmed

Lok Seva Aayog ne bhi Award diye jaane ki sanstuti ki thi

topic: Vishesh jokhim bhare karya mein ghaayal ya mrit sarkari sevakon ko vishesh arthik sahayata
content:
Sarkari sevakon ko vishesh jokhim wale karyon mein mrityu ya ghaayal hone par UP Civil Services Asadharan Pension Niyamavali ke antargat vishesh laabh adhik udaar banaye gaye. Dakaon, aatankwadiyon, videshi aakramankariyon se muthbhed, himsak bheed niyantran, praakritik aapadaon mein seva — sab vishesh jokhim ke karya hain.

100% akshamta par vahi pension jo vishesh jokhim mein mrityu par dey hoti hai

Mrityu par parivar ko anugraha rashi: Class 1=Rs.50000, Class 2=Rs.40000, Class 3=Rs.30000, Class 4=Rs.20000

Gratuity aur anugraha milakar nyuntam Rs.41000 aur adhiktam Rs.105000

Kartavyapal mein gambheer ghaayal hone par tatkal arthik sahayata Rs.5000

Class 3 aur 4 ke liye anugraha bhugtan adhikar Vibhagadhyaksh ko

Class 1 aur 2 ke liye Shaasan ke prashasanik vibhag ko adhikar

topic: Sevanivritt Gratuity aur Mrityu Gratuity ki daren — 01-01-1986 ke baad
issuing_authority: Pramukh Sachiv, Vitt Vibhag, UP Shaasan
content:
01-01-1986 ke baad sevanivritt gratuity sirf unhi sarkari sevakon ko dey hai jinhone 5 varsh ki aharya seva poori kar li ho.

Sevanivritt gratuity hetu nyuntam 5 varsh ki seva anivaarya

Sevanivritt gratuity = antim emoluments ka 1/4 x pratyek poori 6 maahi avadhi — adhiktam saadhey solah gune ya Rs.1 lakh

Mrityu Gratuity: 1 varsh se kam=2 guna; 1-5 varsh=6 guna; 5-20 varsh=12 guna; 20 varsh ya adhik=pratyek 6 maahi ke liye 1/2 adhiktam 33 guna ya Rs.1 lakh

Parivar mein shamil: patni/pati, putra, avivahit/vidhwa putriyaan, 18 varsh se kam bhai, avivahit/vidhwa bahnen, mata-pita, vivahit putriyaan, mrit putra ki santaan

topic: Nayi Paribhashit Anshadan Pension Yojana NPS — 01 April 2005 se laagu
issuing_authority: Vitt Aayukt aur Pramukh Sachiv, Vitt
content:
Rajya sarkar ne 01 April 2005 se sabhee nayi bhartiyyon par Nayi Paribhashit Anshadan Pension Yojana NPS anivaarya roop se laagu ki. Purani Defined Benefit Pension ke sthan par Contributory Pension Yojana laagu hogi.

01-04-2005 se sabhee nayi bhartiyyon par NPS anivaarya

NPS anshadan: vetan aur DA ka 10% karmchari aur 10% sarkar

Pension Tier-1 anivaarya — seva avadhi mein koi aaharan nahi

Pension Tier-2 swaichhik — karmchari apna poorn dhan kisi bhi samay nikaal sakta hai

Sevanivritt par Tier-1 ka 40% anivaarya roop se annuity mein lagana hoga

Shesh 60% ek musht prapt hogi

topic: 01-04-2005 ke baad niyukt police karmiyon ki kartavyapal mein mrityu par aashrit parivar ko Asadharan Pension
issuing_authority: Sanyukt Sachiv, UP Shaasan, Grih (Police) Anubhag
content:
01-04-2005 ke baad NPS ke antargat niyukt police karmiyon ko Asadharan Pension nahi mil pa rahi thi. Shaasan ne antrim vyavastha ke antargat nirnay liya ki UP Police Asadharan Pension Niyamavali 1961 ke praavdhanon ke anusar Asadharan Pension anumeya hogi.

01-04-2005 ke baad NPS mein niyukt police karmiyon par bhi laagu

Kartavyapal mein mrityu par aashrit parivar ko Asadharan Pension dey

Vitt Vibhag ki sahemati se jaari

Antrim vyavastha — aadhikarik sanshodhan alag se jaari kiya jayega

topic: UP Police Asadharan Pension Pratham Sanshodhan Niyamavali 1975 — Rule 3 ka vistar
content:
UP Police Asadharan Pension Niyamavali 1961 mein sanshodhan karke Rule 3 ka daayra badhaya gaya. Ab 01 April 1972 se sabhee police adhikariyon aur karmiyon par laagu — kisi bhi kartavya ke dauran mrityu par.

01-04-1972 se prabhavi retrospective

Sabhee police adhikari aur karmchari — rajpatrit aur arajpatrit dono par laagu

Sirf dakaon se muthbhed tak seemit nahi — kisi bhi kartavya ke dauran mrityu shamil

Rule 4: Award pane wale ke parivar ko UP Civil Services Extraordinary Pension Rules ke antargat koi aur award nahi milega

Rule 5: Rule 3 mein ullekh karan se bhinn kisi karan ki mrityu par koi award nahi

topic: Sevanivritt maamlon mein arjit avkaash ke badle nakad bhugtaan — adhiktam seema 300 din
issuing_authority: Sachiv, UP Shaasan, Vitt Samanya Anubhag-4
content:
Rajyapal ne Vetan Samiti UP 1998 ki sanstuti par avkaash nakad bhugtaan ki adhiktam seema 240 din se badhaakar 300 din karne ki swikriti pradan ki.

Avkaash Nakad Bhugtaan adhiktam seema 240 din se badhaakar 300 din

Sevanivritt, sevarat mrityu, nirbandhit/anivaarya/swaicha sevanivritt par laagu

Formula: anumeya vetan aur bhatte x jama arjit avkaash ke din bata 30 — ab 300 din ki seema par

Aadesh tatkal prabhavi

topic: Pensioner ki mrityu hone par jeevankalin pension ke avshesh ka bhugtaan — Nominee ka namankankaran anivaarya
issuing_authority: Sanyukt Sachiv, UP Shaasan, Vitt Samanya Anubhag-3
content:
Pensioner dwara apni jeevanakalin pension hetu namankankaran nahi kiye jaane ki sthiti mein parivar ko kathinai hoti hai. Form 30 mein namankankaran ki kaarywahi anivaarya roop se pension prapatra bhejne ke samay hi poori ki jaye.

Form 30 mein namankankaran anivaarya — pension prapatra ke sath hi

Nominee ko pensioner ki mrityu ke baad jeevanakalin pension ke avshesh ka bhugtaan kiya jayega

Vartman pensionaron se bhi namankankaran GO dtd 23-05-1962 ke antargat karaaya ja sakta hai

topic: Pension Sevanivritt Gratuity Rashikaran hetu Pension Prapatra Form 1-5
content:
Pension Prapatra mein 5 Bhaag hain: Bhag-1 sarkari sewak ka wyaktigat vivaran, Bhag-2 parivarik pension aur mrityu gratuity hetu praarthi vivaran, Bhag-3 namoona hastakshar aur pahchan chinh, Bhag-4 seva ka itihas, Bhag-5 karyaalyaadyaksh dwara pension gashan.

Bhag-1: Naam, janam tithi, seva aarambh/sevanivritt tithi, antim pad, nominee ka naam

Bhag-2: Mrit sarkari sewak ka vivaran, praarthi ka parichay, parivar vivaran

Bhag-3: Namoona hastakshar, wyaktigat pahchan chinh, passport photo 3 pratiyaan

Bhag-4: Seva ka poora itihas — pad, sthan, avadhi, avkaash, suspension aadi

Bhag-5: Karyaalyaadyaksh kare — aharya seva, average emoluments, pension/gratuity/rashikaran ka gashan
